summary: Diff focuses on mobile stability/usability: adds an app-level error boundary, prevents horizontal overflow globally, makes header responsive with a contained banner image, introduces mobile-safe wrappers for Dialog/Select content, and adds matchId validation plus more defensive navigation/toast error handling on core pages. Some REQ-32 aspects (keyboard/scroll-into-view behavior) are added as a hook but not evidenced as wired into Match Setup/Live Scoring inputs in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure inputs remain visible when the on-screen keyboard is open (e.g., scroll focused inputs into view) in Match Setup and Live Scoring.
missing_requirements.reason: A `useScrollIntoViewOnFocus` hook was added, but the diff summary does not show it being used in MatchSetupPage or LiveScoringPage (or any inputs) to actually keep focused fields visible when the keyboard opens.
